name: v4.30.0
body:
## Highlights - **Mutual connections.** search_people lists a member's connections with `connection_of`. ([#1358](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1358) by @vinkamath) - **Replies by thread id.** reply_to_conversation answers a thread by id, InMail included. ([#1342](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1342) by @shbernal) - **Copied links work.** Job and company tools take the links LinkedIn shows, with slugs. ([#1437](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1437) by @ConnorMoss02) ## Features - reply_to_conversation answers an existing thread by its id, InMail included. ([#1342](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1342) by @shbernal) - search_people takes connection_of to list a member's connections, e.g. mutual connections. ([#1358](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1358) by @vinkamath) - The server can load optional tools at start. ([#1475](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1475) by @stickerdaniel)
Bug Fixes (15) - Connection requests now report pending when LinkedIn hides Pending in the More menu. ([#1425](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1425) by @dgitman) - Job, messaging and post tools refuse invalid input before starting the browser. ([#1429](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1429) by @ConnorMoss02) - --slow-mo 0 now turns off a SLOW_MO set in the environment. ([#1431](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1431) by @ConnorMoss02) - Job tools accept a job search link with currentJobId in place of the job id. ([#1437](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1437) by @ConnorMoss02) - `--port 0` is refused as an invalid port instead of being dropped in favour of 8000. ([#1447](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1447) by @kun654) - Invalid LOG_LEVEL now refuses startup instead of silently keeping the default level. ([#1461](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1461) by @kun654) - An unreadable HEADLESS, AUTO_IMPORT_FROM_BROWSER or DAEMON_ENABLED now stops startup. ([#1479](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1479) by @stickerdaniel) - References keep an external link behind /redir/redirect without a trailing slash. ([#1491](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1491) by @ConnorMoss02) - Job tools accept a slugged job link with a period or escaped character in the title. ([#1493](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1493) by @ConnorMoss02) - References keep an escaped ?, # or / in the target of a LinkedIn redirect. ([#1498](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1498) by @ConnorMoss02) - Company tools accept a slug with an ampersand, such as johnson-&-johnson. ([#1500](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1500) by @ConnorMoss02) - An unknown `LINKEDIN_TRACE_MODE` or `LINKEDIN_MCP_CHECK_FOR_UPDATES` value stops startup. ([#1501](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1501) by @stickerdaniel) - References keep an external link behind /safety/go. ([#1504](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1504) by @ConnorMoss02) - Company tools accept a slug with an apostrophe, such as lowe's-home-improvement. ([#1506](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1506) by @ConnorMoss02) - A job reference is emitted only for a job link that the job tools accept as input. ([#1508](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/pull/1508) by @stickerdaniel)
## Install or update > [!TIP] > New here? The [README](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server#readme) covers setup. ### Update with uvx Clients configured with `mcp-server-linkedin@latest` pick up v4.30.0 on their next start. To pin this release, use `mcp-server-linkedin@4.30.0` instead. ### Update with the MCP Bundle For Claude Desktop, download [linkedin-mcp-server-v4.30.0.mcpb](https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/releases/download/v4.30.0/linkedin-mcp-server-v4.30.0.mcpb) and open it to install or update. Bundles do not update themselves, so repeat this for every release. ### Update the Codex or Claude Code plugin Codex picks up v4.30.0 of the plugin in the background on its next start. In Claude Code, run this and restart: ```bash claude plugin update linkedin-mcp-server@linkedin-mcp-server ``` ### Update with Docker ```bash docker pull stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server:latest ``` Use the `4.30.0` tag instead of `latest` to pin this release. --- **New contributors 🎉** @vinkamath, @dgitman, @kun654 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server/compare/v4.29.0...v4.30.0
